title: Plugin-profiles team config
description: Schema for plugin-profiles.yaml in a repository's convention home (default docs/conventions): the team layer of the plugin-profiles plugin's per-hook on/off settings. Repository profiles live in the plugin-profiles/ directory beside it, not in this file. Keys are listed in plugins/plugin-profiles/README.md, Configuration. Contract: docs/contracts/hook-enablement/README.md.

session_start_profile_enabled.description: Whether the SessionStart hook names the folder's plugin profile and records the profile each session runs in. A user-layer value wins when set; otherwise this repository value overrides the plugin default (true).

plugin_profile_module_enabled.description: Whether the mod registers the /plugin-profile command and runs its /reload-plugins when the turn ends. A user-layer value in pluginConfigs wins when set; otherwise this repository value overrides the plugin default (true).
